automation.description: Signs in as admin in SmartClient (desktop UX/UI) and does what an administrator does to keep the system running: refreshes document data, checks the mail a job sends is logged but not sent, manages the caches, changes and purges the Monitoring Dashboard, and uses the SmartClient-only User Hits and Content tools.

interaction.name: Clear the completed jobs list
interaction.description: Clears the completed jobs list so that this script's job rows can be told from earlier ones.

method.comment: This member waits for its jobs by their rows in the completed jobs list, and pf/09-operations.xml leaves refresh jobs there that this member's log checks would read: clear it first. Safe because every sc/05 to sc/09 member runs after both 05-reports-misc.xml members (which check the backup's row) and before the 98-destructive.xml members. pf/09 must not do this: sc/05 runs after it.

interaction.name: Data Refresh: refused without a refresh option
interaction.description: Presses Refresh in Data Maintenance without choosing a refresh option and checks it is refused with Value required.

interaction.name: Data Refresh: refresh a document, read the job it ran
interaction.description: Starts a data refresh, declining the confirmation once, then waits for the Refresh job in the completed jobs list and checks it is complete and cannot be rerun or cancelled.

method.comment: Declined: the confirmation is answered No, so the refresh is not sent
The refresh is a job: wait for its row in the completed jobs list
The job's log shows it started and finished, and that it refreshed no document

testScript.message: The job log should show a refresh that included no document

method.comment: The job was started with the Data Maintenance bean, which the job record does not keep, so it cannot be rerun; it has finished, so it cannot be cancelled

interaction.name: Mail Log: the mail a job sends is logged, not sent
interaction.description: Turns on test mail in Configuration, runs a refresh that sends a notification, and checks the Mail Log shows the mail skipped and addressed to the test recipient, then puts the mail settings back.

method.comment: Mail is only logged: mailBogusSend is set here (98-destructive.xml sets it too) and put back at the end
The mail was skipped by the bogus send, and says so; it went to the test recipient, not the contact

SmartClient draws the details as separate cells in order (Dispatch Status, Provider, ..., Relay Status, Relay Detail, To Recipients, ..., Subject), so the script joins the visible cells and checks the sequence

testScript.message: The mail log should show a skipped test bogus send to ops{run}@example.com about the refresh

method.testScript: const cells = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div')).filter(d => d.children.length == 0 && d.offsetParent && d.innerText).map(d => d.innerText.trim()).join('|'); return cells.includes('|SKIPPED|SMTPMailService|skipped|testBogusSend|ops' + sail.run + '@example.com|Perform Document Data Refresh - Complete|');
method.comment: Put the mail settings back

interaction.name: Control Panel: caches, evicting and statistics
interaction.description: Opens the Control Panel and checks the cache statistics, evicts the conversation and Hibernate reference caches (declining once first) and checks the conversation cache empties, and checks a built-in cache refuses to be stopped.

method.comment: The statistics open the Results tab and make Download Results available; they count what each cache holds (its disk tier's entries)

testScript.message: The conversation cache should hold the conversations opened so far
Evicting the conversation cache should empty it

method.comment: Only application caches can be stopped and started; the built-in caches refuse

Not scripted: Evict All Cached Metadata (EvictFromCache). On a single customer server it disposes the persistence and leaves the application with no Hibernate session factory, so every later request fails: see findings.md

interaction.name: Monitoring Dashboard: settings are saved, purge forgets the requests
interaction.description: Changes the Monitoring Dashboard's top N setting and checks it is kept and put back, then declines and confirms Purge, checking the earlier requests are forgotten.

method.comment: Use a document nothing else in this member opens, so the purge's effect shows in the request list
Changing a setting saves the dashboard (its Save action)
Put the setting back
Declined: the requests are still listed
The dashboard shows the purge when it is opened again: only the requests since then are listed

interaction.name: User Hits (SmartClient only): the hits count what the administrator does
interaction.description: Reads the administrator's desktop hit count in User Hits, visits two other screens, and checks the count has grown.

method.comment: Every request a signed-in user makes adds a hit to the user's count for the month and device; the list shows nothing until it is fetched, so refresh it
HITS {var:hitsBefore} then {var:hitsAfter}

testScript.message: The administrator's desktop hits should have grown with the requests made

interaction.name: Content (SmartClient only): an uploaded image is listed, and selecting it shows its link
interaction.description: Gives a new contact an image, finds that image in the Data Maintenance Content tab and checks selecting it shows its file name and type, then deletes the contact.

method.comment: Leftover images from other members stay listed (deleting a contact keeps its content), so find this run's by its contact's bizId, which the content row of the contact's text carries, and which its image row shares
The selected content's link names the file and its type

testScript.message: Selecting the image should show its link

method.comment: Delete the contact (its image goes with it)

interaction.name: Content (SmartClient only): reindex the data, the attachments and both, and read each job
interaction.description: Runs Reindex Data, Reindex Content and Reindex in turn, declining once, waits for each job and checks it completes with the expected log line, then starts content garbage collection and checks content.

method.comment: Declined: nothing runs (the next job's row is the first to look for)

testScript.message: The Reindex all data job's log should say Reindex beans complete
The Reindex all attachments job's log should say Reindexing content complete
The Reindex all data and attachments job's log should say Reindexing content complete

testMessage.contains: Content Garbage Collection Job has been started

method.comment: CheckContent compares the content in the data with the index; it reports to the server log only, so check that it runs
